source_snapshot.criteria: No errors or reboot failure; changed setting persists; default matches SPEC.
source_snapshot.script: No bundle; 5 attended/20 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; assigns interactive BIOS changes and visual verification to an operator but omits unsafe random controls and early-initialization risks.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY/HIGH; required platform/reference-code identity, safe dependency-aware matrix, cross-subsystem inventory, preserved evidence and KVM/physical recovery.

old_problem: The historical record left Common Refcode values, defaults, dependencies, inventory criteria and recovery as an Engineering Decision because Master directs all/random modifications and log clearing.
disposition_reason: The approved BIOS rule prohibits all/random modification and establishes safe reversible, one-setting-at-a-time execution with pre/post evidence. Applied to this distinct Common Refcode page, it supplies the safe core method while page-specific defaults, low-level dependencies and hardware-inventory oracles remain runtime project configuration. Existing logs are preserved with markers.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2177, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2178 / Wistron-BIOS-00495-V004 / 0b269029250bce62 was directly read from XLSX, manifest and historical record.

Qualified operator uses KVM/console and preserves baseline/changed/retained/Load-Defaults/restored visual evidence.

test_case.test_name: Controlled Common Refcode persistence, initialization and default-restoration validation
test_case.purpose: Verify each approved reversible Common Refcode control persists and returns to authoritative project defaults without changing expected CPU, memory, UPI, PCIe or critical-device initialization or platform health.
required_package: Qualified BIOS/KVM operator and maintenance window
Project-default and safe dependency-aware value matrix
POST/readiness plus hardware-inventory and error oracle
test_case.test_command: Qualified operator records the baseline Common Refcode page and preserved platform inventory/logs, changes one approved reversible control or coherent dependency group, saves/reboots, validates POST/readiness and CPU/memory/UPI/PCIe/critical-device inventory, re-enters BIOS to prove retention, then performs the approved Load Defaults cycle and compares every scoped value and inventory to Project SPEC. Stop at the first anomaly.
test_case.expected_result: Each approved control persists, every reboot meets signed readiness and inventory/error criteria, and after Load Defaults every scoped value and affected hardware inventory equals the authoritative project oracle.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS only for the approved matrix when screenshots prove retention/restoration and all signed initialization, inventory and error criteria match. Wrong value, no-boot, training/link/device loss or prohibited error is FAIL. Missing values/defaults/inventory/recovery oracle is BLOCKED; no arbitrary value is exercised.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until exact platform/refcode/page, defaults, values/dependencies, expected effects, limits and recovery are signed.
Never execute all/random, security/provisioning or unqualified low-level controls.
Preserve existing SEL/kernel/system evidence; no log clearing.
Operator controls every save/reboot/Load-Defaults/recovery; no automatic retry or CMOS clear.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, authorization and platform/BIOS/reference-code identity
Baseline, changed, saved, retained, Load-Defaults and restored screenshots
Per-phase POST timing and CPU/memory/UPI/PCIe/critical-device inventory
Restored state, discrepancy/recovery record and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop at the first initialization, inventory or error anomaly and preserve evidence. Qualified personnel restore the last-known-good setting through KVM or signed physical/CMOS recovery; do not blindly reboot, clear logs or retry.

source_conflict.reason: Target and acceptance consistently cover Common Refcode persistence/default restoration; the unsafe all/random wording is constrained without reducing coverage.

blocked.reason: The safe manual method is established; project-specific values, inventories and recovery are runtime inputs.
